landing.emptyBody: Bring a Wedding Planner onto the team. They will be able to start working on weddings as soon as you onboard them.

form.subtitle: Create the account, hand off the credentials out-of-band, and the new Wedding Planner is ready to work.
form.usernameHint: Local part only — the platform appends the suffix automatically.
form.passwordHint: Between 10 and 25 characters. Spaces and symbols are allowed.

errors.usernameFormat: Use lowercase letters and digits only (no @, no spaces)
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

confirmation.subtitle: The cleartext password is shown exactly once. Copy it now — you will not be able to see it again.
confirmation.warning: The password cannot be consulted later through the platform. It can only be replaced through a future restore flow — save the value somewhere safe before acknowledging.
